en: Wah! Okay, I remember! You were my mentor in junior high... Coach Igarashi!
Hahaha. Has it already been twenty years since you graduated?
I guess it has... You trained me quite a lot back then. And the training was always something bizarre.
You made me nap all day once. While everyone else on the team was sweating it out under the sun, I slept in the shade all day long.
Is that really what happened? I don't recall that.
You had me do vocal training on the roof, too. You even made me clean your bathroom once, with a toothbrush.
Oh, yeah. That, I remember.
Then there was that one time you made me wax your car. Over and over. And then you admitted that wouldn't help me at all.
Oh, that was hilarious, wasn't it? I got that idea from a movie.
It wasn't hilarious to me... I remember being pretty mad about that. By the way, Coach, what are you doing here? I thought you lived in Tokyo.
Almost right after you kids graduated, an acquaintance got me a job coaching high school ball over here.
Oh, is that right? What a coincidence.
Yep. Of course, I'm retired now. Every day's starting to feel the same, if you ask me.
Huh. I totally had no idea. Glad to see you're looking well.
You're not looking so bad yourself. I heard you left the big leagues long ago, but the way you're built⑬I can tell you haven't lost your passion.
By the way, you're not in any trouble, are you? You seemed to be squabbling with that guy from earlier... You're having a duel over baseball, as I understand it?
Ahaha... You saw that? Uh, let's see. Basically, he's a high school teammate who I guess decided he has some axes to grind.
I see... Think you can beat him?
Oh, definitely. Though, he did used to be a pretty good pitcher. And his determination to beat me is off the charts.
So I don't think victory's gonna come easy.
Hmm. So that's how it is... All right, how about this? Would you like me to train you again?
Come again?
What, is my training not good enough for you?
Oh, no, it's not that. In fact, your training was what got me to the pros.
Then there should be no issue, right? It seems like the training you've done on your own just hasn't been enough.
Do you know why?
Because it's impossible to improve on things you haven't noticed about yourself.
Kinda like correcting a bad habit?
Yup. At present, you only have a subjective awareness of yourself as a batter. That is a very dangerous thing.
Say, if a pitcher exploits a weakness you're not aware of... it'll all be over for you.
To prevent that, I can objectively identify and train the areas in which you're lacking. Like I did when you were just a junior high sprout.
You'd... do that for me?
Yeah. You see, ever since I retired, I've been itching to work with young talent again. And don't worry. I won't ask for a training fee.
Oh, that's music to my ears! Then yes please!
Hahah. Broke as ever, I assume.
Well, let's just get on with your training. You need to regain your instincts and properly assess your showdown.
But if you train like I tell you, victory will be yours.
Sounds good to me, Coach!
Very good. We'll start with some training to sharpen your dynamic visual acuity.
Okey-doke. What's the plan?
Go fishing in Mid Square.
You want me to catch a fish? Seriously?
Did I stutter? Now, be sure to concentrate on the water's flow, ascertain the subtle movements of the float, and reel in your prey at the right time.
When batting, one carefully determines the motion of the pitch, and swings at just the right moment. Same concept.
Okay. That's starting to make more sense. All right, Coach. I'll believe you.
Good, then go fishing. What you catch doesn't matter. Anything'll do.
Loitering around here's a drag, so I'm going back to a bar I found.
It's right here. A bar called First Shot. Once you're done fishing, come see me.
Knowing you, I wouldn't be surprised if you were too broke to buy bait. So here.
You got a <Color:8>Special Worm<Color:Default>.
Right then. Don't keep me waiting too long.
(Mid Square's the big park in the east. Let's see what I can fish up.)
It's amazing, Coach. The ball really did look like it was moving in slow motion.
Hahaha, good. Didn't that turn out the way I said it would?
It sure did! Would you mind training me some more?
Sure, I can do that. You can always find me at the bar. So if you want to get some training, that's where I'll be.
Really appreciate it! Thanks!
Sorry, Coach. I couldn't see the ball go any slower.
It's not that you couldn't see it, Shinada⑬you didn't even try!
Come on, tap into your newfound ability. The ball should appear as if it's moving slower through time.
After a pitch is thrown, press <Action:Button_L1@Cost_Of_A_Swing> before it reaches the plate. The ball will appear as if it were in slow motion.
Now, try what you've learned. If you really gained the insight I intended, the ball should appear like it's moving in slow motion.

You have learned Heat Eye⑬an ability that will serve
you immensely during batting showdowns. To activate it,
wait for a pitch to be thrown and press <Action:Button_L1@Cost_Of_A_Swing> before the
ball reaches the plate. Upon activation, the ball will
appear as though it's moving in slow motion.

Like other Heat Actions, using Heat Eye consumes your
Heat Gauge. As such, your Heat Gauge's remaining Heat
determines how long Heat Eye can be used. You can cancel
out of Heat Eye by pressing <Action:Button_L1@Cost_Of_A_Swing> again.

Your Heat Gauge is the same when you go up to bat as when
you're walking around town and getting into fights. So
before you begin a batting showdown, be sure to check
how much Heat you've built up.

During a batting showdown, you can restore Heat by:
 - Hitting a foul
 - Dodging a beanball
 - Ignoring a pitch

How quickly your Heat Gauge empties depends on how much
you've trained. Train regularly to progressively improve your
overall batting abilities.

A new Heat Eye practice course has been added to the
Beginner Course at the batting center. On this course,
your Heat Gauge is restored after every pitch, so you
can use Heat Eye as much as you like.
There's no specific goal this time. Just try out your new ability. The ball should appear as if it's suspended in time.
Excuse me. Is something wrong?
See, I'm part of a comedy duo, but my partner just quit on me.
We have an audition that's about to start and everything! Man, I dunno what to do...
Hey, wait a minute. I know you! You're that idol, Haruka Sawamura!
Um... Well, yes, I am...
Wow! I can't believe I'm seeing the real you in person! I've been a fan of yours ever since I saw ya on TV!
And you're funny, too! Ya did a great job with the back-and-forth when you were on that talk show! Had some real knee-slappers!
You really think so? I was just trying to talk about what I thought the viewers would like to hear, and it just happened to go well.
But that ain't easy! You got somethin' real special! Hold on, hold on. I'm getting an idea here.
Hmm? What is it?
That's it! Haruka, have ya ever thought about doin' comedy?
Comedy? Me!?
Ya see anyone else here? I'm telling ya, you'd be real good!
This audition comin' up means the world to me. I lost a lot of sleep comin' up with this material! And I've got some really good stuff, don't ya know!
I couldn't stand it if I had to forfeit the audition because my partner quit.
I need a favor. Could ya be my partner? Please? Pretty please!? Ya only need to do it this once!
What!? But I don't have any experience!
Don't worry about that! You've already been on TV loads'a times. That oughta help ya out. It'll be fine!
Besides, it'll be good for yer career to polish yer comedy skills. It could really come in handy for yer work.
Just think of all the successful idols. They're not only attractive and good at singing, but they're all extra charming, right?
Hmm. I guess you're right... But I can't be funny. I don't know any good jokes or anything.
Don't worry about a thing! I already thought up all the material!
All you have to do is have some good comebacks ready when I say somethin' silly or stupid.
I think you'd be great at it! I bet ya could hit me with all kinds of great retorts!
So whaddya say, Haruka? Will ya be the straight man to my fool? The sun to my shine? The tako to my yaki?
(Hmm. It might be a good idea to learn something about comedy. Should I do it?)
All right. I'll give it a try!
Ya will!? All right! Thank you! I have a feelin' this is gonna be great!
In that case, we better come up with a name.
A name for our comedy duo?
That's right. I can actually think of a few right off the bat. See which one ya like.
I like Haru and Haru.
Yeah! Your name starts with Haru, my name starts with Haru... It's a dang perfect name for the perfect team!
I like the Laughmakers.
Yeah! That'll make the audience think we're funny before we've even say a word, right? Pretty great name, huh?
I like the Mola Mola.
Isn't it great? Those things are some of the funniest-lookin' things in the sea, right? People'll think we're hilarious before we even say a word!
Great! Now that we got an all-star name, I'm sure we're gonna be a big hit!
Well, I hate to rush ya, but are ya ready to go now? The audition is about to start.
You mean right now!? But I'm not ready!
Hey, a good comedian's gotta go with the flow! Learn to handle whatever comes her way! It's important to know how to wing it!
Ya have to be able to take sudden pressure like this in stride!
What's a little audition? No big deal, right? You can do this! Now how's about we get to that event hall?
You're right. I can do this!
I'm really sorry. I just don't think I can do it.
I gotcha. I'm not gonna force ya or anything. If you change your mind, come on back again.
Excuse me, Haruo?
Hey, Haruka! Any chance ya changed your mind? Wanna become my comedy buddy?
Ya will!? Alright! Thank you! I just know this is gonna be great!
That's right. I can actually think of a couple right off the bat. See which one ya like.
Great! Now that we've come up with the perfect name, I'm sure we're gonna be a big hit!
Hey, thanks a lot, Haruka! You really saved my bacon!
I'm so glad I could help! But that was just round one of the audition, right? Aren't there more after this?
Yeah, that's the truth, but I don't wanna bother ya none. I'll just find a new partner to do the rest of the audition with, I guess.
I see. Well, I hope you find someone. It would be a shame to fail after coming this far!
Haruka-chan, I know I'm usually the fool, but I gotta be straight with ya for once. I wish you and I could keep going together a little longer.
I mean, yeah! We were pretty good together up there, don't ya think? I bet we could get pretty far, you and me. Think ya could stick around a little longer?
Hmm. I don't know...
Well, it's no skin off my back if ya can't. I understand. But if ya ever get the urge to do some more comedy, I'm always down to split sides and slap knees.
I hang around this area a lot, so ya oughta be able to find me if ya go lookin'. Don't let all the  glitz and starlight up on that idol stage blind ya. You always got a place here.
All right, Haruo. Thank you. I won't forget. I'll be back if I ever change my mind.
Ya will? That's great! Thanks, Haruka!
Oh, by the way, this is the prize for passin' the first round of the audition. I want ya to have it.
Well, see ya around, Haruka-chan! I'll be waitin' right here till the day you change yer mind!
We got some time to spare for now. Let's meet back here again later.
I'm glad ya came back, Haruka-chan. Are ya ready to audition again?
Okay, I'll give it a shot. I'm a little nervous, but I'll do my best.
I know we can do this! Now, c'mon! Let's hustle to that event hall!
Sorry, I'm not feeling confident enough yet.
They're holdin' the comedy audition here. Today's the first round. Those who pass all three rounds get a spot on the comedy show.
I see. But I'm only helping out for today, aren't I? What will you do for the second round onward?

Well, I'll worry about that when I come to it!
I'm sure everything'll work out fine! Wahaha!
Oh. Okay, then. Our turn is coming up soon, isn't it? I'm feeling a little nervous.
Just be yourself. You're gonna do fine, Haruka-chan. How 'bout we rehearse a little?
